title.zh: CFTC批准Coinbase将指数期货转换为永续合约
title.en: CFTC Grants Coinbase Relief to Convert Index Futures into Perpetual Contracts

current_state.zh: CFTC已为在美国受监管衍生品市场提供真正的永续期货合约扫清障碍，为这一全球主导的加密衍生品在美国监管下于本土交易打开了大门。
current_state.en: The CFTC has cleared the way for true perpetual futures contracts to be offered in regulated US derivatives markets, opening the door for the dominant global crypto derivative product to be traded onshore under US oversight.

updates.title_zh: CFTC工作人员给予豁免，允许将指数期货转换为真正的永续合约
updates.title_en: CFTC Staff Grants Relief to Convert Index Futures Into True Perpetuals
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC工作人员给予豁免，允许将指数期货转换为具有连续资金费率的真正永续合约，为符合美国规定的永续型衍生品铺平了道路。
updates.what_changed_en: CFTC staff granted relief permitting index futures to be converted into true perpetual contracts with continuous funding, easing the way for US-compliant perpetual-style derivatives.

updates.title_zh: CFTC允许Coinbase将25年期指数期货转换为永不到期合约
updates.title_en: CFTC Lets Coinbase Turn 25-Year Index Futures Into Contracts That Never Expire
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC已允许Coinbase将其25年期指数期货转换为永不到期的永续合约，为美国受监管衍生品市场引入加密式永续期货打开了大门。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC has allowed Coinbase to convert its 25-year index futures into perpetual, never-expiring contracts, opening the door for crypto-style perpetual futures in the US regulated derivatives market.
